About.title: Mediterranean meals made simple, healthy, and unforgettable.
About.subtitle: Healthy Mezze celebrates fresh ingredients, easy recipes, and balanced Mediterranean-inspired eating designed for every home cook.
About.ourStoryParagraph1: Healthy Mezze was created to make healthy Mediterranean cooking simple, approachable, and enjoyable for everyone. Inspired by the rich culinary traditions of Egypt, Lebanon, Greece, Turkey, Syria, Jordan, and Palestine, our goal is to help home cooks prepare delicious meals using fresh ingredients and straightforward techniques.
About.ourStoryParagraph2: Every recipe is designed with everyday home kitchens in mind. We focus on balanced nutrition, practical ingredients, clear step-by-step instructions, and authentic Mediterranean flavors that are easy to recreate at home.
About.valuesTitle: Built on flavor, health, and tradition.
About.commitmentTitle: What you can expect from Healthy Mezze
About.commitmentDescription: We strive to publish recipes that are carefully written, easy to follow, and inspired by authentic Mediterranean cooking traditions. Our nutrition information is intended for general guidance and should not replace professional medical or dietary advice.
About.ctaTitle: Ready to make Mediterranean cooking part of your routine?

Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Healthy Mezze uses cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience, analyze website traffic, remember your preferences, and support essential website functionality.

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites recognize your browser, remember your preferences, and improve overall performance.

whyWeUse.title: Why We Use Cookies
whyWeUse.intro: Healthy Mezze uses cookies for several purposes, including:
items: Keeping the website secure and functioning correctly.
Remembering your language and display preferences.
Saving your favorite recipes and user settings.
Understanding how visitors use the website through analytics.
Improving website speed, performance, and user experience.
Supporting advertising and measuring ad performance.

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.description: Required for the website to function properly. These cookies cannot be disabled because they enable core features such as navigation, security, and page functionality.

preferences.title: Preference Cookies
preferences.description: Remember settings such as your selected language, theme, and other personalized preferences.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.description: Help us understand how visitors interact with Healthy Mezze so we can improve content, navigation, and overall user experience.

advertising.title: Advertising Cookies
advertising.description: May be used by advertising partners, including Google AdSense, to display relevant advertisements and measure advertising effectiveness.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.content: Some cookies are placed by trusted third-party services that help us operate Healthy Mezze. These may include analytics providers, embedded content providers, and advertising networks.

managing.title: Managing Cookies
managing.content: Most web browsers allow you to control or delete cookies through your browser settings. You can block or remove cookies at any time, although some features of Healthy Mezze may not function correctly if essential cookies are disabled.

consent.title: Cookie Consent
consent.content: Where required by law, we request your consent before placing non-essential cookies on your device. You can change your cookie preferences at any time.

changes.title: Changes to This Cookie Policy
changes.content: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in legal requirements, technology, or our services. Any updates will be posted on this page together with the updated revision date.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about our use of cookies or this Cookie Policy, please contact us through our Contact page.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.metaDescription: Learn how Healthy Mezze collects, uses, and protects your information.
Privacy.intro: Healthy Mezze respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have regarding your data when you use our website.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.body: By accessing Healthy Mezze, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. We encourage you to read this page carefully to understand how your information is handled.

information.title: Information We Collect
information.body: Depending on how you interact with Healthy Mezze, we may collect the following information:

items.email: Email address when you voluntarily subscribe to our newsletter.
items.pages: Pages you visit and how long you stay on them.
items.time: Date and time of your visit.
items.analytics: Anonymous analytics data collected through services such as Google Analytics.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: We use analytics tools to better understand how visitors use Healthy Mezze. These tools collect anonymous information that helps us improve the website, user experience, and our recipe content.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.body: If you choose to subscribe to our newsletter, we only use your email address to send recipes, cooking tips, updates, and occasional announcements.
newsletter.unsubscribe: You can unsubscribe at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link included in every email.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, update, or request deletion of your personal information. You may also object to certain processing activities where permitted by law.

clarity.title: Our Commitment
clarity.body: Healthy Mezze never sells your personal information. We collect only the information necessary to operate, improve, and secure our website.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Healthy Mezze uses cookies to improve website functionality, remember your preferences, analyze traffic, and provide a better browsing experience.
cookies.preferences: You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings at any time.

adsense.title: Advertising
adsense.body: Healthy Mezze may display advertisements through Google AdSense. Google and its partners may use cookies to serve personalized or non-personalized advertisements based on your browsing activity.

links.title: External Links
links.body: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of external websites.

security.title: Data Security
security.body: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information. However, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is completely secure.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be published on this page together with the updated revision date.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, please contact us at:
